purpose: Define maturity levels for Level 3 House inhabitants so objects progress from mere labels toward inspectable dossiers without forcing every object into the full entity-dossier schema.

levels.meaning: Object is placeable and discoverable but still thin.
Object has enough boundary language to be safely interpreted.
Object can be inspected beyond a summary through at least one substantive facet.
Object can support a bounded case/dossier view and explicit uncertainty.
Real-world institution/entity has enough scale, longitudinal evidence and relationships to warrant the full dossier contract.

rules: Project concepts and navigation artifacts may stop at faceted/case-ready if a full real-world entity dossier would be category error.
Sensitive real-world organizations should not be publicly centered at seed maturity if status/evidence boundaries are missing.
Questions do not count as evidence.
Adding facets should deepen one object rather than duplicate the same facts into multiple Room-specific copies.
Maturity is about inspectability and evidence discipline, not importance.
